One of the best BR's to ever exist. I've been playing since season 1 on console. After all this time I still enjoy it's movement, it's gunplay, it's maps, and especially all the different variety of characters and abilities. It still calls me to this day. The maps are absolutely iconic to me. Every single different ability, enables me to change up my game style. You end up finding out who you're best with, who you suck with, and as well as, who you are better with as a team. You can win a game with just about any character. But nothing since its inception, has come close to this game. A lot of respect to the OG Dev's who created this game. I can keep going on and on... Peace out, Champions.

For a game of this caliber, the company behind it is astoundingly incompetent and borderline fraudulent. More than a day ago, I spent some money for Apex Coins, the digital currency of the game. However, I'm yet to receive my Apex Coins, or any replies from support that are remotely useful. Live support has either given me astronomical wait times, or transferred me to another "department" that gave me more astronomical wait times (HOURS!!!). In other words, they took my money and started obstructing my attempts to get what I bought!

If I went downstairs and shoplifted from a supermarket, I would be arrested. EA, on the other hand, gets to steal without any accountability! EA should be shut down for theft, and all of management deserve to be arrested for not only systematically stealing from players, but also the f**king embarrassment of a company they are. Notwithstanding the other terrible aspects of Apex as a game, the inability of a billion dollar corporation to TAKE MY GODDAMN MONEY in return for LITERAL DIGITAL COINS is beyond me. 

If you are considering playing this game and see this review, you are in luck. Let this be a warning for you to never touch this game in your life. This is why we play Valorant instead folks.
